hard_constraints: Single POV: Ben Skywalker throughout (project contract: 'pov_structure': 'Single POV — Ben Skywalker throughout')
'Steady Returns' is the canonical ship name for Desh's modified YT-series light freighter; italicize as ship name in prose (terminology_registry)

Force described through experiential/mystical language, not scientific; render body-experience before diagnostic terms like 'resonance' or 'chord' (force_mechanics.sensory_vocabulary.concept_vs_sensation_rule)
Avoid forbidden repeat phrases like 'reached for the Force' (force_mechanics.vocabulary_variation.forbidden_repeat_phrases)
No in-universe use of ABY/BBY, 'Legends', 'Canon', or meta-references (canon_profile.meta_reference_rules)
canon_risks: Ensure Ben's perception of the new seal aligns with authorized Weave-Resonance mechanics (shared-burden containment distributing load across traditions; feels like emergent warmth/chord after discord, not rigid structure) without implying universal ontology change

Desh as non-Force-sensitive must not perceive the resonance directly; his role is operational/practical (force_mechanics.sensory_vocabulary.weave_resonance.non_force_sensitive: absence of wrongness only)
legends_continuity_notes: In 47 ABY post-Fate of the Jedi, Jedi Order headquartered at Coruscant Temple under Grand Master Luke Skywalker; Galactic Alliance primary government (canon_profile.era_description)
Coruscant Temple approach standard: orbital traffic control, visible from orbit amid ecumenopolis (standard Legends hyperspace exit/decel to planetary approach)
Ben Skywalker: Jedi Knight, ~20-21 years old, son of Luke/Mara, GAG service history with Desh (canon_constraints.canon_preserved)
required_context_for_drafter: New seal's resonance for Ben: discordant notes finding emergent relationship; physical warmth through Force after unweaving cold; flexible/dynamic Weave like living tissue; relief not triumph (force_mechanics.force_mechanics.force_mechanics.force_mechanics.sensory_vocabulary.weave_resonance.force_sensitive)
Transform from Ch1 'wrongness' (persistent low-grade distortion) to belonging/chord without explicit callback narration (scene_card.anti_patterns, notes)
Ben/Desh: Shared GAG past as dormant pressure; Desh practical anchor, non-sensitive operational frame (ensemble_cast.Desh.weiland_arc, relationship_arcs.Ben/Desh)
Setting: Cramped YT-series freighter cockpit; hyperspace blue viewport to realspace decel; Temple visible on Coruscant approach (terminology_registry.Steady Returns, scene_card.sensory_details)
Emotional arc: Reflective processing (listen to hum) -> determined resolution (delete drafts) -> courage of honesty (Temple threshold) (scene_card.emotional_arc, key_beats)
allowed_au_divergences: Existence/persistence of new shared-burden Weave-Resonance seal post-climax; humming chord at edge of Ben's perception as permanent distributed load (canon_constraints.canon_overridden, force_mechanics.primary_rule, terminology_registry.Weave-Resonance)
Ruusan Reformations as penance for Veranthos wound/seal (canon_constraints.canon_overridden)
Ben's mission outcome: Institutional truth-telling to Luke/Order about thousand-year cover-up (concept_seed.conflict.lock_in_mechanism, chapter_blueprint.relationship_turns)
